captures.alt: Open Brace Select popup with search field, East and West choices, disabled Central choice, and Android keyboard
captures.caption: A searchable single Select exposes option descriptions and a disabled state with the Android keyboard open.
captures.usage:
var selectedKey by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
var expanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
val options = listOf(
    BraceSelectOption("east", "east", "East"),
    BraceSelectOption("west", "west", "West"),
)
BraceSelect(
    options = options,
    selectedKey = selectedKey,
    onSelect = { selectedKey = it.key },
    expanded = expanded,
    onExpandedChange = { expanded = it },
    label = "Region",
)

captures.alt: Brace DataTable viewport in light mode with fixed headers, row labels, and Case 1001 selected
captures.caption: The in-progress DataTable renders a bounded viewport with fixed headers and controlled cell selection.
captures.usage:
data class CaseRow(val id: String, val name: String)
val rows = listOf(CaseRow("1", "Case 1000"), CaseRow("2", "Case 1001"))
val columns = listOf(
    BraceTableColumn<CaseRow>("name", "Case", 160.dp, cellText = { it.name }),
)
var selection by remember { mutableStateOf<BraceTableSelection?>(null) }
BraceDataTable(
    rows = rows,
    rowKey = { it.id },
    columns = columns,
    selection = selection,
    onSelectionChange = { selection = it },
    label = "Cases",
)

captures.alt: Brace DatePicker showing September 2026 with selected September 18, disabled weekends, and month shortcut
captures.caption: A locale-aware DatePicker with weekday selection, disabled weekends, and an end-of-month shortcut.
captures.usage:
var selected by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>("2026-09-18") }
BraceDatePicker(
    value = selected?.let(LocalDate::parse),
    onValueChange = { selected = it?.toString() },
    locale = Locale.US,
    minDate = LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 1),
    maxDate = LocalDate.of(2026, 10, 31),
    isDateEnabled = { it.dayOfWeek.value <= 5 },
    shortcuts = listOf(BraceDateShortcut("End of month", LocalDate.of(2026, 9, 30))),
    initialMonth = YearMonth.of(2026, 9),
)

captures.alt: Brace TimePicker showing hour and minute steppers at 23:30 in an overnight range, a Meeting time field, and a disabled time field in light mode
captures.caption: The in-progress native TimePicker pairs bounded hour and minute steppers with a localized editable time field and a disabled state.
captures.usage:
var selected by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("23:30") }
BraceTimePicker(
    value = LocalTime.parse(selected),
    onValueChange = { selected = it.toString() },
    locale = Locale.US,
    use24Hour = true,
    minTime = LocalTime.of(22, 0),
    maxTime = LocalTime.of(2, 0),
)
BraceTimeField(
    value = LocalTime.parse(selected),
    onValueChange = { selected = it?.toString() ?: "23:30" },
    label = "Meeting time",
    locale = Locale.US,
)
